snippet.title: Last Mage - Demo Release
snippet.description:
Fight your way through the hordes of monsters emerging from the underground. Obligated with an almost impossible task, you must descend into the catacombs of the desecrated temple to eliminate this calamity.

Your motivation? Getting your freedom back.

Spell-Based Combat: Harness destructive magic in roguelite, bullet heaven battles.
Strategic Backpack Management: Arrange, rotate, and upgrade inventory blocks to unlock powerful synergies.
Artefacts & Loot: Discover strange magical relics and experiment with their dangerous interactions.

Play the demo now!
